jobs.occupation: Commodity Manager (m/w/d) Machined parts Generator (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) and take the lead in strategic procurement for Machined Parts for Large Generators. You will develop and align a resilient Ecosystem strategy in collaboration with commodity circles, ensuring it aligns with Siemens Energy’s global strategy and business objectives for Large Gas Turbines and Steam Turbines. By implementing a global Ecosystem strategy, you will support our business targets of Growth, Resilience, and Cost Out. Your expertise in supply market knowledge will go beyond procurement perspectives, generating significant value and impact.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide vision, strategy, and functional leadership to a global commodity team, embodying ownership, innovation, and transformation aligned with Siemens Energy’s values.
* Lead and develop your team in commodity management, contract negotiations, supplier relationship management, and strategy implementation, while negotiating global frame contracts and price lists.
* Collaborate with Strategic Procurement leadership and key customers to enhance commodity structure and organization, sharing valuable supplier market intelligence across Siemens Energy.
* Develop and implement forward-looking commodity ecosystem strategies that align with business needs, leveraging enhanced Commodity Circle networks to drive value creation.
* Manage relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure alignment with company demands, facilitating early supplier involvement and driving cost-out initiatives.
* Identify procurement risks and opportunities through supplier market analysis and scouting, integrating findings into ecosystem strategies for continuous improvement of managed spend.

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree, or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field, along with extensive experience in procurement, ideally within a global organization.
* Strong commercial and technical understanding of procurement, project management, and international contract law.
* Proven experience in functional leadership and project management.
* Long-term experience in a multinational Procurement/Supply Chain function.
* Exceptional negotiation and analytical skills.
* Fluent in both English and German.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

• 
Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

• 
Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

• 
Supporting training sessions and workshops 

• 
Gathering and tracking user feedback 

• 
Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

• 
Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

• 
Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

• 
Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

• 
Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

• 
Coordinating meetings and workshops 

• 
Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

• 
Preparing presentations and communication materials 

• 
Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

• 
Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

• 
Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

• 
Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

• 
Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

• 
Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

• 
Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

• 
Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

• 
A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

• 
Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

• 
Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

• 
Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

• 
Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

• 
A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.occupation: OT Security Architect - Renewables, Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

• 
Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

• 
Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

• 
Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

• 
Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

• 
Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

• 
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

• 
Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

• 
Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

• 
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

• 
Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

• 
Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

• 
Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

• 
Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

• 
Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

• 
Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

• 
Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.occupation: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

• 
Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

• 
Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

• 
Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

• 
Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

• 
Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

• 
Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

• 
Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

• 
Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

• 
Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

• 
Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

• 
Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

• 
Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

ENGLISH:

Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)

Do you imagine a position where you play a key role in an engaged and committed team creating professional film projects?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and still deliver great results? 

Are you able to facilitate film production and at the same time create a supreme client experience, both in the studio and on location?

As producer at AVdesign you will get the chance to work in a top professional, positive and encouraging work environment with like-minded individuals who have a strong passion within their field. We value rich opportunities for professional and personal development. 

 

About us

We are a Billund based international production company. AVdesign was founded in 2005 and now employs 16 colleagues including animators, CG generalists, producers, production assistants, sound designers, videographers etc.

We create a great variety of content across different platforms and support clients worldwide with a range of exciting projects.

AVdesign is located together with My Instore Radio and in total we employ 26 skilled colleagues of different nationalities.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our video team, where we have gathered some of the most skilled and dedicated enthusiasts from the business. The team consists of 6 people.

 

About the role

This is a maternity cover position, offering a unique opportunity to join AVdesign and play a key role in coordinating and delivering a wide range of media productions.

We are looking for an experienced Producer / Production Manager with a strong background in production planning and project coordination.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and adaptable, with an open mindset and a flexible approach to a broad range of assignments. Our projects vary across video production, live streaming, studio product shoots, and other media-related productions, so versatility and a willingness to take on different challenges are important.

At AVdesign, we foster an open, supportive, and collaborative working environment where sharing knowledge, ideas, and experience is highly valued.

Experience within the media industry, such as video production, live streaming, or broadcast, is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

This is a hands-on role that combines operational coordination with practical involvement in productions. It requires a genuine interest in planning, problem-solving, and collaborating with colleagues, clients, and partners to ensure successful project delivery.

 

About you

You are a natural coordinator who enjoys bringing people, plans, and ideas together. You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks at once. Whether coordinating logistics, supporting creative productions, or solving last-minute challenges, you take ownership and help keep projects on track. Fluency in Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your profile:

·      Experience in a coordination, project support, administrative, or production-related role.

·      Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

·      Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats, contributing wherever needed to support the team and deliver great productions.

·      Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

·      Experience with light photo editing, video editing, or basic graphic design is an advantage.

·      A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a flexible approach to changing priorities.

·      Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

·      A positive team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others succeed.

 

Additional information

If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you soon. Potentially we are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

The role is based in Billund, Denmark. Remote working is not an option. 

If you have any question about the job, please get in touch on: application@avdesign.dk

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV on: application@avdesign.dk

We will interview potential candidates on an ongoing basis and deactivate the job advert once the position has been filled.

jobs.occupation: Senior Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software developer with a passion for building high-quality applications? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with business experts to create solutions that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.  

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with five Senior Developers and two Lead Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role   

As a Senior Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative team of approximately 23 developers. Together, you will design, develop, and maintain internal applications that support our current and future business services. Working closely with product owners, architects, engineers, operators, and UX specialists, you will help translate business needs into robust technical solutions. 

You will be part of an application team that values sustainable solutions over quick fixes. We actively collaborate across applications and business services to identify common solutions, increase quality, and continuously improve the way we work. 

What you will do:

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET. 

• 
Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code following established design patterns and development standards. 

• 
Transform complex engineering and operational requirements into effective software solutions by collaborating closely with architects, product owners, engineers, operators, and UX designers to build solutions that meet business and operational needs. 

• 
Contribute to technical improvements, modernization efforts, and continuous optimization of existing applications. 

• 
Participate in code reviews and help ensure high quality, reliability, and maintainability across solutions. 

• 
Support troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 

• 
Serve as a technical role model within the team and mentor colleagues who are developing their technical skills. 

• 
Stay current with new technologies, tools, and development practices relevant to Nordic RCC's technology landscape. 

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  
C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

• 
Databases & Storage 
Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

• 
Tooling and collaboration  
Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines 

We’re looking for someone with:  

• 
Collaborative Mindset: You work closely with Application Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers, contributing technical expertise, mentoring colleagues, and helping to ensure maintainable, scalable, and robust solutions. 

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

• 
Relevant Expertise: Experience developing enterprise-grade applications in C#/.NET, with a solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and modern development practices. 

• 
Continuous Improvement: You identify opportunities to improve code quality, system reliability, team practices, and developer productivity. 

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes.  

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required.  

 
If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111

jobs.occupation: Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?

At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for an engineering student to join our Project Management team in Kolding, either as an intern or a student worker.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we coordinate projects, from technical requirements and planning to delivery. Along the way, you will learn how mechanical solutions, customer expectations, budgets and deadlines influence project decisions.

What you will be doing
You will support our project managers in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting project planning and following up on milestones, deadlines and outstanding actions.
• Preparing and updating project documentation, status reports and meeting materials.
• Participating in project meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across Engineering, Sales, Production, Installation and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on project costs, changes and risks.
• Contributing ideas to improve project processes and ways of working.

As you develop your understanding of our projects, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.

Who we are looking for
You are studying Mechanical Engineering, Global Business Engineering or a related engineering programme. You have a good understanding of mechanical principles and an interest in the business side of engineering, particularly how technical decisions affect costs, delivery and customer value.

We also imagine that you:

• Are curious about project management and eager to apply your knowledge in practice.
• Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
• Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
• Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.

jobs.occupation: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

• 
Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

• 
Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

• 
Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

• 
Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

• 
Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

• 
Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

• 
Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

• 
Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

• 
Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

• 
National or European research and innovation funding 

• 
Development of collaborative funding proposals 

• 
Consortium building and partner identification 

• 
University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

• 
Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

• 
Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

• 
Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

• 
Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

• 
Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

• 
Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

• 
Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

• 
Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

• 
Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

• 
Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

• 
Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

• 
Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

• 
Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

• 
Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

• 
A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.
